_note: JSON schema describing the structured knowledge fields that the iterative extractor produces per chunk. The extractor outputs a dict with four keys; the rolling state merges them across chunks. This matches the v2.1 extraction schema — v2.1 renamed 'axioms' to 'findings' and dropped 'use_cases' from the prior version.

concepts._description: Named entities that should become ontology individuals or classes (materials, methods, instruments, applications).

fields.name: Canonical name as it appears in the paper (string, required)
fields.category: One of: Material | Process | Property | Method | Condition | Instrument | Application
fields.aliases: Alternative names or abbreviations used in the paper (list of strings, optional)
fields.evidence_sentence: Full verbatim sentence from the chunk that mentions this concept (string, required)
fields.evidence_context: 1-2 sentences either side of evidence_sentence for context (string, required)
fields.confidence: high | medium | low — calibrated to how explicitly the chunk states this (string, required)
fields.mentions: Count of how many times this concept has appeared across chunks (integer, auto-managed)

example.name: poly(styrene-co-methyl methacrylate)
example.evidence_sentence: We synthesised poly(styrene-co-methyl methacrylate) via RAFT polymerization at 70 °C.
example.evidence_context: The copolymer was prepared in bulk. We synthesised poly(styrene-co-methyl methacrylate) via RAFT polymerization at 70 °C. The resulting material had Mn = 24,500 g/mol.

relations._description: Subject-predicate-object triples linking concepts. Predicates should come from the relation_types list in domain_priors.json when possible.

fields.subject: Concept name (string, required)
fields.object: Concept name or literal value (string, required)
fields.evidence_sentence: Full verbatim sentence from chunk supporting this relation (string, required)
fields.evidence_context: 1-2 sentences either side for context (string, required)

example.subject: poly(styrene-co-methyl methacrylate)
example.evidence_sentence: We synthesised poly(styrene-co-methyl methacrylate) via RAFT polymerization at 70 °C.
example.evidence_context: The copolymer was prepared in bulk. We synthesised poly(styrene-co-methyl methacrylate) via RAFT polymerization at 70 °C. The resulting material had Mn = 24,500 g/mol.

properties._description: Measured numeric properties with their values, units, and the material they characterise.

fields.material: Concept name the property belongs to (string, required)
fields.property_name: Property name from concept_categories.Property in domain_priors.json (string, required)
fields.numeric_value: Number reported, or null if qualitative (number or null)
fields.method: Concept name of the method used to measure this, or null
fields.evidence_sentence: Full verbatim sentence from chunk (string, required)
fields.evidence_context: 1-2 sentences either side for context (string, required)

example.evidence_sentence: Mn = 24,500 g/mol as determined by GPC using PS standards.
example.evidence_context: The resulting material was characterized thoroughly. Mn = 24,500 g/mol as determined by GPC using PS standards. Dispersity Đ was 1.14.

findings._description: Empirical observations, conclusions, or cause-effect statements reported in the paper. Named 'findings' (not 'axioms') because papers report experimental results, not formal OWL axioms.

fields.evidence_sentence: Full verbatim sentence from chunk (string, required)
fields.evidence_context: 1-2 sentences either side for context (string, required)

example.statement: Increasing the MMA feed ratio decreases the glass transition temperature of the copolymer.
example.evidence_sentence: Tg decreased monotonically as the MMA feed fraction rose from 0.2 to 0.8.
example.evidence_context: DSC measurements were performed at 10 °C/min. Tg decreased monotonically as the MMA feed fraction rose from 0.2 to 0.8. This trend was consistent across all molecular weights tested.
